macro.label: Macro & Central Banks
macro.description: Central bank decisions, inflation prints, GDP, yield curves, and FX

items.headline: Fed's Williams: Central bank has 'work to do' to return inflation to target
items.summary: Per Reuters, Federal Reserve official reiterates data-dependent stance without new rate guidance. RBC reports global central banks remain focused on inflation risks, consistent with post-CPI hawkishness.
items.relevance: Reinforces near-term Fed hold bias; sets up US CPI release as primary macro catalyst for positioning.

items.headline: Gold rebounds but heads for weekly fall before US inflation data
items.summary: Reuters reports precious metals volatility as market awaits CPI print; gold down on weekly basis despite intraday bounces, signaling risk-off sentiment ahead of inflation data.
items.relevance: Real yield dynamics; gauge of Fed expectations; signals macro positioning ahead of key data release.

items.headline: Central banks remain focused on inflation risks
items.summary: Per RBC, global central bank policy stance continues to emphasize inflation vigilance. No new rate decisions or guidance published in 48-hour window.
items.relevance: Backdrop for European and EM central bank stance; supports CAUTIOUS positioning on credit until inflation trajectory clarifies.

macro.keyTakeaway: If US CPI on Tuesday moves materially off consensus, Fed terminal rate expectations and duration positioning will reprrice within 48 hours; energy and EM FX carry flows will follow.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitics & Security
geopolitics.description: Conflicts, alliances, sanctions, and power shifts

items.headline: Microsoft outage affecting Teams, Outlook, and Copilot; not cyber-security incident per company statement
items.summary: BBC reports that Microsoft-wide outage remains largely unresolved after 48 hours; company rules out external cyber attack but remediation efforts slow. Impact spans enterprise communications and AI software.
items.relevance: Systemic operational risk to institutional investors' infrastructure; potential margin pressure on cloud/SaaS positions if outage persists or signals infrastructure fragility.

items.headline: Nvidia scandal implications: executive conduct allegations, export scrutiny, and governance concerns converge
items.summary: Per Al Jazeera and Asia Times, Nvidia faces multiple pressures: CEO resignation (Asia Times reports this week), intelligence allegations, and semiconductor export controls to China under scrutiny. Governance and geopolitical risk compounding.
items.relevance: US-China chip competition escalates; Nvidia valuation and strategic positioning directly implicated; affects broader semiconductor supply-chain confidence and US tech regulatory environment.

items.headline: China warns US against additional AI chip export controls
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports Beijing cautionary statement on fresh US semiconductor restrictions. Follows existing export limitations and amid Nvidia governance turbulence.
items.relevance: Signals escalation risk in US-China tech decoupling; affects US semiconductor stocks, cloud capex cycles, and EM supply-chain diversification plays.

items.headline: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over Iran nuclear site; Isfahan uranium enrichment plant inspection denied for over one year
items.summary: BBC reports IAEA maintains inability to inspect announced Iran facility. Escalation in nuclear transparency breakdown coincides with Strait of Hormuz shipping incidents.
items.relevance: Backdrop for oil price range and energy supply disruption risk; informs geopolitical premium in energy complex.

geopolitics.keyTakeaway: If Nvidia governance or semiconductor export controls deteriorate further this month, US tech equity leadership risk re-prices; Iran nuclear opacity + Strait mine incidents keep energy risk premium in place.

fdi.label: FDI & Capital Flows
fdi.description: Cross-border investments, sovereign wealth, and capital movements

items.headline: SpaceX plans over $74 billion investment in Texas and Arizona AI campuses
items.summary: Per Reuters Capital, SpaceX announced large-scale capital commitment to AI infrastructure in US. Reflects broader tech-sector capex concentration in Sunbelt and compute facilities.
items.relevance: Demonstrates mega-scale private capital deployment into US real assets and infrastructure; signals where institutional and corporate growth capex is concentrating this cycle.

items.headline: Mercedes-Benz halts German investments as plant closures loom
items.summary: Reuters Capital reports OEM capex freeze amid restructuring. Signals retrenchment in traditional European automotive base and re-weighting toward EV and cost reduction.
items.relevance: European industrial capex weakness; affects European bank lending to autos, German supplier ecosystem, and eurozone growth expectations.

items.headline: Cross-border investors turn net buyers; Asia-Pacific property investment reaches $167 billion
items.summary: Per Institutional Real Estate, Inc., institutional capital flows into Asia-Pacific real estate marked reversal to net inflows. Reflects regional economic resilience and capital reallocation from Western markets.
items.relevance: Capital rotation into EM real assets; validates CONSTRUCTIVE Emerging Markets stance; supports Asia-focused family office positioning.

items.headline: Kenya calls for increased private sector participation in African infrastructure; Sierra Leone prepares West Africa investment summit
items.summary: Per Facebook and African Business, African governments signal openness to private capital in infrastructure. Freetown summit positioning West Africa as investment destination.
items.relevance: Infrastructure project pipeline growth in Africa; entry point for private equity and infrastructure funds; selective deployment opportunity at country and sector level.

fdi.keyTakeaway: If Asia-Pacific real estate inflows persist and African infrastructure summits yield bankable projects, cross-border LPs will rebalance away from saturated Western markets into selective EM assets; European industrial capex contraction accelerates this shift.

critical-minerals.label: Commodities & Energy
critical-minerals.description: Oil, gas, metals, supply chains, and energy security

items.headline: Oil prices slip as US maintains Iran blockade; WTI near $88, Brent below $96
items.summary: Per EnergyNow, oil prices consolidating in lower range despite ongoing Iran supply disruption. Trump statement on unlikely new Iran strikes (WSJ) removes tail-risk premium.
items.relevance: Energy cost inflation moderates; supports margin recovery in energy-intensive sectors and dampens inflation pass-through; validates CONSTRUCTIVE Energy view.

items.headline: Pakistan LNG Limited tenders for two cargoes; delivery mid-December and early January amid winter gas crisis
items.summary: Per Business Recorder via OilPrice, state energy agency seeks emergency LNG supply as domestic shortage pressures winter heating. Reflects global LNG supply tightness and seasonal demand surge.
items.relevance: LNG spot pricing and shipping capacity at risk; supports long-term energy security costs for South Asia; implicates European winter gas adequacy if LNG diverted.

items.headline: Iran tanker hit mine in Strait of Hormuz; incident via unauthorized route per IRGC
items.summary: Per OilPrice, Iranian state source reports gas tanker strike and explosion. Raises Strait transit risk and insurance costs; reflects ongoing militarization of waterway.
items.relevance: Energy supply route risk; tanker insurance and shipping costs; backdrop for oil risk premium persistence despite price consolidation.

items.headline: Global energy markets survived eight months of Iran war disruptions; Americans facing higher prices, rest of world confronting shortages
items.summary: Per OilPrice, analysis suggests energy markets adapted to Iran conflict but with asymmetric burden: developed consumers face inflation, developing nations face actual supply gaps.
items.relevance: Validates energy cost pass-through risk to EM economies; supports EM inflation and central bank policy tightening; affects EM FX carry and debt sustainability.

items.headline: Guinea gold mining crackdown leaves 10 dead; mass expulsions and exodus spark Mali humanitarian crisis warning
items.summary: Per Mining.com, Guinea government enforcement action against artisanal mining triggers regional displacement and security deterioration. Mali warns of humanitarian escalation.
items.relevance: Gold supply disruption risk from West Africa; geopolitical instability in resource-rich region; affects gold prices and mining equity valuations.

critical-minerals.keyTakeaway: If Pakistan LNG winter crisis deepens and Strait of Hormuz mine incidents escalate, energy and LNG shipping costs re-price upward; West African mining instability compounds precious metals volatility.

items.relevance: Real estate market segmentation; suburban office/retail conversion opportunity; affects regional property valuations and tenant demand patterns.

real-estate.keyTakeaway: If insurance cost inflation persists in US multifamily and Madrid political risk materializes, secondary market valuations and operator IRRs compress; industrial and suburban mixed-use conversion opportunity remains selective play.

items.headline: Have Trump's tariffs blocked Chinese EVs from the US market?
items.summary: Per DW, analysis examines tariff effectiveness in excluding Chinese EV imports. Reflects ongoing tariff-based trade restrictions in auto sector.
items.relevance: US auto tariffs protecting domestic OEM and battery supply chains; supports selective US industrial capex; affects Chinese EV export strategy.

items.headline: EU's shaky start to balancing trade with China; mixed trade policy signals
items.summary: Per GIS Reports, EU trade policy toward China shows inconsistency. Reflects internal EU disagreement on protectionism vs. engagement.
items.relevance: European trade policy fragmentation; affects European supply-chain resilience and China relations; validates MIXED Europe regional signal.

trade-policy.keyTakeaway: If US Republican tariff constraints hold and EU trade policy stabilizes, tariff escalation risk moderates; India bilateral advantage persists, and China EV/export strategy adapts to sustained Western protectionism.
